newsitem.title: POLAND: POLISH THOMSON UNIT EYES 97 MKT SHARE RISE.
newsitem.headline: POLISH THOMSON UNIT EYES 97 MKT SHARE RISE.

text.p: Thomson Consumer Electronics Poland, a unit of the French Thomson, expects to sell 150,000 TV sets next year, raising its market share from eight to 12 percent, the company's head of marketing said on Monday.
PAP news agency quoted Marek Lacki as saying the company also expected to reach a net profit of 150 million zlotys in 1997 against an anticipated 100 million this year.

Thomson opened a television-set factory in Piaseczno near Warsaw in 1991, bringing an investment of $185 million. It has a network of 1,000 shops all over Poland and 58 service offices, PAP said. -- Warsaw Newsroom +48 22 653 9700
